name: modules-model-external-unreachable
about: modules.modelProvider 绑到一个没有人监听的本机端点（127.0.0.1:9）：server 照常启动（基线启动时不探测模块）；轮次里取 manifest 失败（MODULE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE，HttpModuleClient.ts:122-130），本轮失败；下一轮重新取 manifest（失败的 manifest 不缓存）。比较帧与落盘。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  modelProvider:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: bbx.model
    contract: pilotdeck.model/v1
    transport: module-http-v2
    endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9
    manifestPath: /mp/module-manifest
    callPath: /mp/call
    methods:
      - prepare
      - stream
